tips.text: Take whatever element Ergo offers; Elemental Vice swaps it at rank 40, so a 60% Impact roll is fine.
Take the first usable Agendus and stop chasing 60% unless you are min-maxing.
Players call it among the best sword-and-shields, and the farm draws little complaint.
Expect an hour or two of Veil storms for one copy, and about double to valence-max a low roll.
